description.value: The Camellia Tea Room is a volunteer-run café occupying the former drawing room of the historic Milner estate, set within the Milner Gardens & Woodland botanical property on the outskirts of Qualicum Beach with views over the Salish Sea. The seasonal menu draws directly on produce grown in the estate gardens and features house-made scones, rotating soups, and desserts alongside teas sourced from the local Denman Island Tea Company. It is a genuinely distinctive stop on Vancouver Island's cycling routes, though cyclists should note that garden admission is required to access the tea room.

address.value: 2179 Island Hwy W, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1G1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the tea room is a real, operating business within Milner Gardens & Woodland at 2179 Island Hwy W, Qualicum Beach — address sourced from the contact page since OSM has none. Several menu items are explicitly labeled GF, DF, and VG, confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific infrastructure was found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website contact page.
Garden admission is required to access the tea room (confirmed on visitor info page) — cyclists must pay entry to the gardens to use the café.
Phone number listed (250-740-6380) is for the Executive Director; no single main public phone number is provided for the tea room directly.
Cash is not accepted at the Camellia Tea Room (debit/credit only, no AMEX) — noted on visitor info page.
No bike parking infrastructure of any kind mentioned on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café within a public botanical garden near Qualicum Beach; the website confirms current operations and seasonal menu. A distinctive and worthwhile stop for touring cyclists in the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The tea room is run primarily by volunteers and is part of Vancouver Island University's Milner Gardens & Woodland property. A dedicated Tea Room Supervisor (Jason Doyle, Jason.Doyle@viu.ca) is listed on the contact page.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labeled: Chocolate Cake (GF and DF), Lemon Blueberry Tart (VG - fully vegan), Seasonal Garden Bounty Soup (GF and VG), Salish Sea Chowder (GF and DF, with vegan salmon-free variant)
